name: Quest International University

fees.notes: QIU does not publish programme fees; its pages state fees/funding are by enquiry (checked 2026-09-18). International totals listed by Uni Enrol range from USD 3,200 to USD 89,762.55 depending on programme; six programmes have no published international fee. See individual programme records. Source: https://unienrol.com/study-malaysia/quest-international-university-qiu (accessed 2026-09-18).

description: Based in Ipoh, Perak, QIU is a private university offering cutting-edge Foundation, Diploma, Bachelor's Degree and Postgraduate programmes. We #DreamBig.
